description: Track the user's habits in DayHeart. mark marks a habit for today or a past day (a count habit: value is the amount for the day, without value one more; a quit habit: a slip that day); unmark removes the day's mark. add adds a habit (title; kind check, count with target and unit, or quit; days of the week; section of the day; reminder times). update changes the title, target, unit, days, section or reminders; archive and restore hide a habit or bring it back.

date.description: For mark and unmark: YYYY-MM-DD, today or a past day. Default: today

days.description: Days of the week. Default: every day

id.description: Habit id, from the habits list

kind.description: For add: check (done or not), count (an amount toward a target) or quit (a habit the user is quitting)

reminders.description: Reminder times HH:MM, up to 6; an empty list removes them

target.description: Count habit: the amount for a day, 1 to 100000

unit.description: Count habit: unit, up to 20 characters, e.g. "glasses"

value.description: For mark of a count habit: the amount for the day, 0 to 100000

name: change_habits
title: Change habits
